title: Add global stats
body: The tiles are currently out of alignment.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: Stats page has been removed from the collection pages (will probably implement later for the global site)

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
User quote to show the need for this 

> since you remove the Statistics（ the original ： https://www.LibCrowds.com/statistics/）,I can't get some informations from that such as the daily/weekly degree of activity， if convenient , If  permited，may I  have a look？(*/ω＼*) For a research...

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: This also came up during the Kent Uni workshop - so some indication of who the other users are - esp. make sure to put back the world map.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: When we eventually get to this, we can use the update feed from http://docs.pybossa.com/en/latest/api.html#account-index to get the latest actions on the server (users created, contributions, new tasks, etc.).

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: Following GDPR changes we no longer store real IP addresses for our users, so the map stuff (although never quite implemented) no longer makes sense. We could consider added some more charts somewhere but I don't think this is urgent.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: Let's scrap this - IPs have been anonymised now, so no more location maps. Plus, we can use Jupyter notebooks for more analytical things.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: We should remove the mapbox config var though

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
